  def start_mq(self):
    # Override method, when asr is restarted kill this app
    def _on_node_remove(self, name: str, mode: str):
      self.logger.info(f"MQ release {self.name} with {name}")
      if name in self.nodes:
        self.nodes.remove(name)
      if name == "asr":
        os._exit(1)

    self.mq._on_node_remove = types.MethodType(_on_node_remove, self.mq)
    wfasr = self.mq.wait_for_handshake("asr")
    try:
      self.mq.startup()
    except:
      os._exit(1)

    self.mq.logger.info("Wait for asr node to startup")
    wfasr.join()

    self.mq.subscribe(channel_job_done(), self.on_job_done)
    self.mq.subscribe(channel_job_error(), self.on_job_error)
    self.mq.subscribe(channel_job_status(), self.on_job_status)
    self.mq.subscribe("jobs-status", self.on_jobs_status)

  def stop(self):
    self.executor.shutdown()
    self.mq.destroy()
